source.citation: Liu et al., Long-lived remote ion-ion entanglement for scalable quantum repeaters, Nature 652, 51-57 (2026), arXiv:2602.08472
source.parameter_location: main text Figs. 2-3 and author dataset Fig_3b.xlsx/Fig_3d.xlsx
source.mapping_status: the 10 km memory-memory link, rate, initial fidelity, and storage data were demonstrated in one system; the fidelity-preserving isotropic twirl is an explicit composability adapter and was not reported as part of the experiment

validity.distance_semantics: total spooled telecom fiber between the two ion nodes and the midpoint single-photon interference station
validity.route_scope: one demonstrated elementary link only; no local memory-memory Bell-swap process was demonstrated in this system

hardware.resource_semantics: one calcium-40 ion at each demonstrated remote node; no undeclared spatial multiplexing or additional memory slots

rate_model.completion_time_evidence: the author Fig_3d interval histogram is evaluated against the 2.226 Hz exponential probability-density model
rate_model.rate_semantics: 2.226 cps is the demonstrated link operating-point rate at alpha=17%; 0.291/s is separately reported for the long-running DI-QKD valid-data accumulation and is not substituted into the elementary renewal model

state_model.reported_operating_point: alpha=17%, lower central fidelity of the two herald branches in author dataset Fig_3b.xlsx
state_model.twirling_semantics: after each public herald outcome is corrected into the psi-minus Pauli frame, the lower of the two measured central fidelities is used as a conservative common envelope and an explicit bilateral Clifford twirl maps the pair to the isotropic Bell-diagonal state (F,(1-F)/3,(1-F)/3,(1-F)/3) without increasing its measured Bell fidelity; the 2.226 Hz rate retains both herald outcomes
state_model.twirling_implementation_status: composability adapter grounded in standard LOCC, not reported as executed by Liu et al.; local twirl-control errors and duration are not activated
state_model.activation_blocker_beyond_one_link: the source does not supply a local two-memory Bell-swap process or Bell-outcome confusion matrix for this node

storage_decoherence_model.coherence_time_definition: exponential fit to the remote-pair XX coherence under 0.5 ms-interval KDD at alpha=17%
storage_decoherence_model.source: main text Fig. 3d and author dataset Fig_3d.xlsx

memory_model.decay_semantics: the 1.16 s D5/2 lifetime and measured linear ZZ degradation are retained as known unmodeled conditional-state effects; they are not relabelled as heralded pair loss
memory_model.known_storage_limitation: the executable histogram applies the measured exponential XX dephasing law, but not the separately observed linear ZZ degradation from accumulated KDD gate errors

controller_model.scheduling: one-link empirical exponential renewal only; no multi-link controller or swap is activated

histogram_adapter.optical_stack_semantics: the demonstrated source, 393-to-1550 nm conversion, phase stabilization, fiber, SNSPD heralding, and their errors are already aggregated into the measured link rate and conditional pair state; repository Fock optical components are bypassed rather than multiplied again

notes: This is a current 10 km demonstrated-link anchor that executes as an accepted remote-memory-pair instrument. It coexists with the Cui-2026 12 km hybrid-multiplexed repeater-node baseline and the separately archived Cui two-node ion-ion result. Multi-hop use fails closed until an explicit compatible local-swap process is composed.
